verdict.rationale: Codex generates summaries, diffs, and follow-up suggestions from a user's codebase (codex-docs-5, codex-docs-6), which can be seen as a narrow form of 'insights from data,' but this is limited to code artifacts rather than broader data insights. Community feedback is mixed on quality and reliability of its agentic reasoning (codex-comm-3, codex-comm-13, codex-comm-15).
